annotations.title: Generate FAR 52.219-9 Small Business Subcontracting Plan & eSRS Goals

description: Calculate Small Business subcontracting dollar and percentage goals across SB, SDB/8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, and HUBZone categories (under both % of Total Subcontracted Dollars and % of Total Contract Value baselines), draft all 15 mandatory elements of a FAR 52.219-9 Small Business Subcontracting Plan and DFARS 252.219-7003 Small Business Participation Commitment Document (SBPCD), and structure eSRS.gov ISR/SSR reporting and FAR 52.219-16 Liquidated Damages good-faith effort controls. This is a read-only, stateless, non-destructive subcontracting compliance and goal calculator (requires X-RapidAPI-Key; `solicitation_subcontracting_and_clin_text` accepts 20 to 45,000 characters, while `plan_type_and_regulatory_regime` and `agency_socioeconomic_goal_benchmarks` calibrate Individual, Master, or Commercial Subcontracting Plans against DoD or Civilian SBA statutory targets). Use this tool when preparing a Large Business Prime FAR 52.219-9 Small Business Subcontracting Plan, DFARS 252.219-7003 Small Business Participation Volume, or eSRS ISR/SSR goal calculation; use `generate_teaming_strategy` instead when a Small Business Prime needs a 13 CFR 125.6 (50% Rule) Limitations on Subcontracting workshare split, or `generate_sources_sought_response` for pre-RFP Rule-of-Two set-aside shaping.

agency_socioeconomic_goal_benchmarks.description: Agency statutory or RFP-mandated small business subcontracting goal percentages across SB, SDB/8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, and HUBZone (defaults to 'DoD_23Pct_SB_5Pct_SDB_5Pct_WOSB_5Pct_SDVOSB_3Pct_HUBZone').

plan_type_and_regulatory_regime.description: Subcontracting Plan structure: Individual Plan, Master Plan + Individual Goals, or Commercial Subcontracting Plan under FAR 52.219-9 / DFARS 252.219-7003 (defaults to 'Individual_Subcontracting_Plan_FAR_52_219_9_And_DFARS_252_219_7003').

solicitation_subcontracting_and_clin_tex.description: Total contract ceiling, Base + Option period breakdown, total planned subcontracted dollars, RFP Section L/M Small Business Participation factor targets, and named subcontractor commitments (20 to 45,000 characters).

name: generate_small_business_participation

dfars_small_business_participation_commi.description: Actionable checklist for DFARS 252.219-7003 Small Business Participation Commitment Document (SBPCD) enforceability.

esrs_isr_ssr_reporting_and_good_faith_ef.description: eSRS.gov ISR/SSR reporting calendar, FAR 52.219-16 Liquidated Damages good-faith effort controls, and outreach procedures.

far_52_219_9_15_element_compliance_narra.description: Drafted compliance narratives covering the 15 mandatory elements of FAR 52.219-9(d).

socioeconomic_category_goal_table.description: Socioeconomic subcontracting goal breakdown across SB, SDB/8(a), WOSB, SDVOSB, and HUBZone showing both % of subcontracted spend and % of total contract value.

subcontracting_plan_overview.description: Executive summary and dual-baseline financial breakdown of total contract value vs. total subcontracted spend.
